name: dsh-remote
description: Reach the DSH web UI from a phone or tablet browser on the same network: a zero-dependency Node TLS gateway with a password gate, plus browser polyfills and a responsive layout layer injected into DSH's own page.

scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && node tests/test-polyfill.mjs && node tests/test-tosorted.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:smoke
